name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Mutual NDA — standard terms covering confidential information protection between two parties evaluating a business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA — the fillable signature page that incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement — governs SaaS and cloud-hosted product access, covering service, restrictions, privacy, payment, term, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement — for early-access product users who provide feedback to help the provider develop and improve the product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement — defines uptime and response time targets, service credit remedies, and related definitions for cloud services.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement — governs delivery of professional services including deliverables, IP ownership, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement — covers GDPR and international data transfer compliance, processor/subprocessor relationships, security incidents, and deletion of personal data.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement — governs on-premise or self-hosted software licensing, including restrictions, payment, warranties, and IP reservation.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement — governs business partnership arrangements including obligations, trademark licensing, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement — governs time-limited product trials and evaluations prior to entering a definitive commercial agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement — HIPAA-compliant agreement governing the handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) by a business associate on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper Standard AI Addendum — supplements a base agreement to address AI-specific concerns including model training restrictions, input/output ownership, and AI service disclaimers.
